title: Programmable timer: 24-stage ripple counter with 1-of-16 stage select, oscillator and monostable (CMOS)

sources.document: onsemi MC14536B Programmable Timer datasheet MC14536B/D Rev. 15 (October 2025)

pins.name: SET
pins.text: high: Decode Out forced high at once and all 24 stages reset; the oscillator stops

pins.name: RESET
pins.text: high: Decode Out forced low at once and all 24 stages reset; the oscillator stops

pins.name: IN1
pins.text: clock input; the counter advances on its falling edge; also the oscillator input with OUT1/OUT2

pins.name: 8BYPASS
pins.text: high: the first 8 stages are bypassed

pins.name: CLOCKINH
pins.text: clock inhibit: high holds the count

pins.name: OSCINH
pins.text: oscillator inhibit: high stops the RC oscillator

pins.name: MONOIN
pins.text: monostable timing pin: to VSS disables the monostable (Decode Out is then the selected stage); a resistor to VDD enables it

functions.formula: OUT1 = IN1 AND NOT SET AND NOT RESET AND NOT OSCINH
functions.text: follows IN1; forced low by SET, RESET or OSC INH (function table page 2).
the opposite of OUT1 (function table page 2).
with MONO-IN at VSS: the counter stage picked by D,C,B,A (stages 9-24, or 1-16 of the shortened counter with 8-BYPASS high); high after SET until the first falling clock edge; low after RESET.

state.changesOn: falling edge of the internal clock (IN1 through the oscillator stage), each later stage on the falling edge of the one before
rules: SET high: all 24 stages reset, Decode Out latch set (Decode Out high)
RESET high: all 24 stages reset, Decode Out low
after SET goes low: the first falling clock edge makes Decode Out low, counting starts on the second
CLOCK INH high: the count is held
8-BYPASS high: stage 9 is clocked directly, so the counter has 16 stages

electrical.notes: VDD 5 V, 25 C, minimums: OUT1/OUT2 source -0.51 mA at 4.6 V; Decode Out (pin 13) source -0.88 typ (-0.51 min) mA at 4.6 V; sink 0.51 min / 0.88 typ mA at 0.4 V. Input 0 below 1.5 V, 1 above 3.5 V at VDD 5 V. Drives two low-power TTL loads or one low-power Schottky load (pages 1, 3).

timingLimits.text: clock pulse width, VDD 5 V (300 ns typ)
reset pulse width, VDD 5 V (500 ns typ)

unknown: The behaviour model is for MONO-IN at VSS (monostable off), as on the card. With the monostable on, Decode Out is a pulse whose width is set by the resistor and capacitor; that is not modelled.
Whether CLOCK INH going low by itself, while the clock is low, counts as a falling edge is not stated. The model uses CK = OUT1 OR CLOCKINH, so it would count in that case.
The function table shows '-' for OUT1/OUT2 while CLOCK INH is high; the formula for OUT1 does not use CLOCK INH.
With 8-BYPASS high, the data sheet does not say whether the first-edge rule after SET also applies to stage 9; the model applies it.
SET and RESET both high (with 8-BYPASS high) is the test mode (Figure 9, not read); its behaviour is not modelled.
The datasheet gives delays only to internal stages (no pins), so timing is empty; see notes.
notes: Typical delays at VDD 5 V, CL 50 pF, 25 C (page 4): clock to stage 1 with 8-BYPASS high 1800 typ / 3600 max ns; with 8-BYPASS low 3.8 / 7.6 us; clock to stage 16 7.0 / 14 us; reset to Qn 1500 / 3000 ns; pin 13 rise/fall 100 / 200 ns. The card drawing names pin 3 D, pins 9-12 A0-A3, 15 MONO, 2 RESET, 1 SET, 6 8BY, 14 OSC, 7 CLK, 13 Q, 4 Y, 5 Y~.

internal.formula: SEL = (NOT A AND NOT B AND NOT C AND NOT D AND FF9) OR (A AND NOT B AND NOT C AND NOT D AND FF10) OR (NOT A AND B AND NOT C AND NOT D AND FF11) OR (A AND B AND NOT C AND NOT D AND FF12) OR (NOT A AND NOT B AND C AND NOT D AND FF13) OR (A AND NOT B AND C AND NOT D AND FF14) OR (NOT A AND B AND C AND NOT D AND FF15) OR (A AND B AND C AND NOT D AND FF16) OR (NOT A AND NOT B AND NOT C AND D AND FF17) OR (A AND NOT B AND NOT C AND D AND FF18) OR (NOT A AND B AND NOT C AND D AND FF19) OR (A AND B AND NOT C AND D AND FF20) OR (NOT A AND NOT B AND C AND D AND FF21) OR (A AND NOT B AND C AND D AND FF22) OR (NOT A AND B AND C AND D AND FF23) OR (A AND B AND C AND D AND FF24)
